rows.actualSource:
Chickens can help an empty bed after harvest. They scratch through plant remains and eat some insects and weed seeds. Their manure and bedding can be composted and returned to the soil. Foraging does not replace a balanced diet, clean water, shelter or daily care.

A chicken tractor is a moveable, floorless pen. Move it before the ground becomes bare, muddy or heavily covered with manure. The right time depends on the birds, soil and weather. There is no single number of chickens that guarantees enough fertility for every plot.

Keep chickens away from seedlings and crops being harvested for food. Fresh manure can carry germs. Ask an extension adviser how to manage manure safely before the next crop. Ducks scratch less, but can still damage plants and make wet ground muddy. Watch the birds and move them when needed.
rows.runtimeTarget:
Dzikhuhu (chickens) dzi nga thusa bede ḽa tsimu (garden bed) ḽi si na zwilimiwa murahu ha khaṋo. Dzi pala fhasi kha zwo salaho zwa zwimela nahone dzi ḽa zwiṅwe zwikhokhonono (insects) na dziṅwe mbeu dza weeds. Manure yadzo na bedding zwi nga itwa compost nahone zwa vhuyiswa kha mavu. U ḓiṱoḓela zwiḽiwa a hu dzhii fhethu ha zwiḽiwa zwi fanelaho (balanced diet), maḓi o kunaho, vhudzulo kana u londwa ḓuvha na ḓuvha.

Chicken tractor ndi pen ine ya nga sudzuluswa, i si na fhasi (floorless). Ni i sudzuluse phanḓa ha uri mavu a sale a si na tshithu (bare), a vhe na matope kana a fukedzwe nga manure nnzhi. Tshifhinga tsho teaho tshi ya nga zwiṋoni, mavu na mutsho (weather). A hu na nomboro nthihi ya dzikhuhu (chickens) ine ya fulufhedzisa fertility i ḓadzaho ṱhoḓea dza plot iṅwe na iṅwe.

Thivhelani dzikhuhu (chickens) u swika kha seedlings na zwilimiwa zwine zwa khou kuvhanganywa u itela zwiḽiwa. Manure ntswa i nga vha na germs. Vhudzisani extension adviser nḓila ya u langa manure nga tsireledzo phanḓa ha zwilimiwa zwi tevhelaho. Dakisi (ducks) a dzi pali fhasi nga maanḓa sa dzikhuhu, fhedzi dzi nga kha ḓi tshinya zwimela na u ita uri mavu a re na maḓi (wet) a vhe matope. Lavhelesani zwiṋoni ni zwi sudzuluse musi zwi tshi ṱoḓea.
